# temps_project_container_security (Resource)

Linux capabilities a project's containers may keep beyond Temps' hardened default. Adding one needs `acknowledge_risks = true`. Destroying the resource leaves the setting as it is.

Import with `<project_id>`.

Required API key permissions: `projects:read`, `projects:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_project_container_security" "web" {
  project_id           = temps_project.web.id
  allowed_capabilities = ["NET_BIND_SERVICE"]
  acknowledge_risks    = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `allowed_capabilities` (Set of String) Capabilities kept, for example `NET_BIND_SERVICE`.
- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project.

### Optional

- `acknowledge_risks` (Boolean) Confirm the trade-offs of the capabilities added. Temps never returns it, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `<project_id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project_id>
terraform import temps_project_container_security.web 8
```
